context: R33 method/architecture decision after installed R32 audit closure
objective: Extend Windows Full System beyond WARP without falsely claiming incomplete UDP/system coverage.

facts.claim: sing-box TUN auto_route is supported on Windows; routing-loop prevention is explicitly provided by route.auto_detect_interface/default_interface/outbound.bind_interface.
route.auto_detect_interface binds outbound connections to the default NIC to prevent routing loops under TUN on Windows.
sing-box supports SOCKS and native Shadowsocks/VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Hysteria2 outbounds; config can be validated with sing-box check.
FreeNet Hub Node runtime exposes a project-owned SOCKS inbound on 127.0.0.1:19460 and routes to the selected native Node outbound with auto_detect_interface.
Current gateway PC_TUNNEL is hardcoded to WARP. CFON authoritative gateway config says udp=false; GOOL udp is unknown; Tor SOCKS path is not a general UDP-capable system tunnel.

decision.autoSystemPolicy: If target country is explicit, AUTO resolves to NODE; otherwise AUTO resolves to WARP.
nodeSystemAcceptance: selected NODE HTTPS health and strict TCP exit-country must pass before TUN
SOCKS5 UDP STUN through NODE must pass before TUN
if target country explicit, UDP public IP country must match target before TUN
generated PC_TUNNEL config must pass sing-box check
post-TUN HTTPS + YouTube + UDP STUN must pass
if target country explicit, post-TUN TCP and UDP countries must match target
all failure paths rollback TUN and only stop the exact provider started by this gateway

rejected.option: Enable all methods as Full System immediately
rejected.reason: Would overclaim capability where UDP is missing or unverified and could break games/console-like UDP traffic.

rejected.option: Treat Tor/CFON SOCKS as sufficient Full System
rejected.reason: TCP-only/proxy reachability is not sufficient evidence for full system TCP+UDP semantics.
